contracts.description: swe/pr-reviewer agent_runs completed in the last 7 days and not marked unmeasured carry tokens
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_runs
             WHERE agent_type IN ('swe','pr-reviewer') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', completed_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND (usage_source IS NULL OR usage_source <> 'unmeasured')
               AND COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(tokens_out, 0) = 0
               AND COALESCE(cache_read_tokens, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(cache_creation_tokens, 0) = 0

SELECT id, task_id, agent_type, usage_source, completed_at FROM agent_runs

               AND (usage_source IS NULL OR usage_source <> 'unmeasured')
               AND COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(tokens_out, 0) = 0
               AND COALESCE(cache_read_tokens, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(cache_creation_tokens, 0) = 0

contracts.description: tasks closed in the last 30 days and more than TMB_REVIEW_GRACE_HOURS (default 24) ago have a passing pr-reviewer verdict, a bro-written review_gate_waived row, or a review_gate_bypassed row from bro or hook:close-issue-on-merge (bro_atomic_close closes before pr-reviewer runs; tasks has no closed_at, so the close time is updated_at)
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :grace_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts v WHERE v.task_id = t.id AND v.verdict = 'pass')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit a WHERE ((a.event_type = 'review_gate_waived' AND a.from_node = 'bro')
      OR (a.event_type = 'review_gate_bypassed' AND a.from_node IN ('bro', 'hook:close-issue-on-merge')))
                                AND CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.branch_id, t.updated_at FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :grace_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts v WHERE v.task_id = t.id AND v.verdict = 'pass')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit a WHERE ((a.event_type = 'review_gate_waived' AND a.from_node = 'bro')
      OR (a.event_type = 'review_gate_bypassed' AND a.from_node IN ('bro', 'hook:close-issue-on-merge')))
                                AND CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id)
             ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 5

             GROUP BY CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END, COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') END, '') HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

             WHERE a.event_type = 'spec_shape_gate_waived'
               AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
                                 WHERE t.id = CAST(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END AS INTEGER)
                                   AND CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) = CAST(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END AS TEXT))

             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at)) FROM verification_runs)

             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at)) FROM verification_runs)
               AND COALESCE(t.commit_sha, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(t.verification, '[]') NOT IN ('', '[]')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit w WHERE w.event_type = 'verification_gate_waived' AND CASE WHEN json_valid(w.content_json) THEN json_extract(w.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id)

contracts.sample_sql: SELECT id FROM agent_runs WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days') AND NOT (agent_type = 'bro' AND task_id IS NOT NULL) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND exit_reason IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: tasks.prompt_bearing NULL rate over rows created in the last 30 days stays at or under 0
contracts.sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN prompt_bearing IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) FROM tasks WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
contracts.sample_sql: SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days') AND prompt_bearing IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: agent_runs.effort NULL rate over SubagentStop-metered swe/pr-reviewer rows since the first run carrying an effort created in the last 30 days, per-task bro rows excluded stays at or under 0.05
contracts.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN effort IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) FROM agent_runs WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days') AND NOT (agent_type = 'bro' AND task_id IS NOT NULL) AND agent_type IN ('swe','pr-reviewer') AND usage_source = 'subagent_stop'
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) >= (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at)) FROM agent_runs WHERE effort IS NOT NULL)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT id FROM agent_runs WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days') AND NOT (agent_type = 'bro' AND task_id IS NOT NULL) AND agent_type IN ('swe','pr-reviewer') AND usage_source = 'subagent_stop'
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) >= (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at)) FROM agent_runs WHERE effort IS NOT NULL) AND effort IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no closed issue still has a pending/running/needs_validation/completed task
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM issues i JOIN tasks t ON t.issue_id = i.id
             WHERE i.status = 'closed' AND t.status IN ('pending','running','needs_validation','completed')
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT i.id AS issue_id, t.id AS task_id, t.status FROM issues i JOIN tasks t ON t.issue_id = i.id
             WHERE i.status = 'closed' AND t.status IN ('pending','running','needs_validation','completed') ORDER BY i.id DESC, t.id LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no L2 concept is suspect or broken (a scan found an anchored step changed or gone, or a claim failing): re-verify it with world_model_concept_upsert or retire it
contracts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_concepts WHERE status IN ('suspect','broken')
contracts.sample_sql: SELECT id, repo, name, status, status_reason FROM wm_concepts WHERE status IN ('suspect','broken') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no concept a closed, reviewed task proposed in its completion report (report.concepts) is still pending — no concept_proposal_applied or concept_proposal_rejected row for its task and name — 7 days after the close (tasks has no closed_at, so the close time is updated_at): scan_run applies a proposal once its anchors are in the scanned checkout's index
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t,
               json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(t.completion_report) THEN t.completion_report ELSE '{}' END, '$.concepts') c
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts va
  WHERE va.task_id = t.id AND va.verdict = 'pass' AND va.created_at >= (
    SELECT MIN(a.created_at) FROM audit a
      WHERE a.event_type = 'bro_verification_pass' AND json_valid(a.content_json)
        AND json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') = t.id
        AND json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') = t.commit_sha))
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit p
                                WHERE p.event_type IN ('concept_proposal_applied','concept_proposal_rejected')
                                  AND CASE WHEN json_valid(p.content_json) THEN json_extract(p.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id
                                  AND CASE WHEN json_valid(p.content_json) THEN json_extract(p.content_json, '$.name') END = json_extract(c.value, '$.name'))
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT t.id AS task_id, json_extract(c.value, '$.name') AS name, t.updated_at FROM tasks t,
               json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(t.completion_report) THEN t.completion_report ELSE '{}' END, '$.concepts') c
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts va
  WHERE va.task_id = t.id AND va.verdict = 'pass' AND va.created_at >= (
    SELECT MIN(a.created_at) FROM audit a
      WHERE a.event_type = 'bro_verification_pass' AND json_valid(a.content_json)
        AND json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') = t.id
        AND json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') = t.commit_sha))
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit p
                                WHERE p.event_type IN ('concept_proposal_applied','concept_proposal_rejected')
                                  AND CASE WHEN json_valid(p.content_json) THEN json_extract(p.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id
                                  AND CASE WHEN json_valid(p.content_json) THEN json_extract(p.content_json, '$.name') END = json_extract(c.value, '$.name')) ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no concept_proposal_rejected row from the last 30 days (a reviewed task's concept proposal still failed to upsert 14 days after its close; content_json.error names why)
contracts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit a WHERE a.event_type = 'concept_proposal_rejected' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', a.created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT a.id, a.issue_id, a.created_at, a.content_json FROM audit a
             WHERE a.event_type = 'concept_proposal_rejected' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', a.created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
             ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no repo with 100 or more wm_symbols rows has no live (non-retired) wm_concepts row: the L1 index is there but nobody has written its L2 concepts
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT repo, COUNT(*) AS symbols FROM wm_symbols GROUP BY repo HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) s
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wm_concepts k WHERE k.repo = s.repo AND k.status <> 'retired')
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT s.repo, s.symbols FROM (SELECT repo, COUNT(*) AS symbols FROM wm_symbols GROUP BY repo HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) s
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wm_concepts k WHERE k.repo = s.repo AND k.status <> 'retired') ORDER BY s.symbols DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: every in-symbol-scope wm_files row is indexed at this extractor version (symbols_md5 = content_md5:1). A row stamped ':failed' threw on read or extraction and stays out of the symbol index until its content changes (indexRepoSymbols' failed_paths names the error); an unstamped or stale row was skipped because its repo's symbol pass threw (scan_run's symbols.error) — rerun scan_run
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_files WHERE NOT (path GLOB 'dist/*' OR path GLOB '*/dist/*' OR path GLOB '*.map'
               OR path GLOB 'build/*' OR path GLOB '*/build/*'
               OR path GLOB 'node_modules/*' OR path GLOB '*/node_modules/*'
               OR path GLOB 'vendor/*' OR path GLOB '*/vendor/*' OR path GLOB '*.min.js'
               OR path = 'package-lock.json' OR path GLOB '*/package-lock.json'
               OR path GLOB '*.lock' OR path GLOB '*.lockb')
               AND symbols_md5 IS NOT content_md5 || ':' || '1'
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT repo, path,
             CASE WHEN symbols_md5 GLOB '*:failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN symbols_md5 IS NULL THEN 'unstamped' ELSE 'stale' END AS state,
             updated_at FROM wm_files WHERE NOT (path GLOB 'dist/*' OR path GLOB '*/dist/*' OR path GLOB '*.map'
               OR path GLOB 'build/*' OR path GLOB '*/build/*'
               OR path GLOB 'node_modules/*' OR path GLOB '*/node_modules/*'
               OR path GLOB 'vendor/*' OR path GLOB '*/vendor/*' OR path GLOB '*.min.js'
               OR path = 'package-lock.json' OR path GLOB '*/package-lock.json'
               OR path GLOB '*.lock' OR path GLOB '*.lockb')
               AND symbols_md5 IS NOT content_md5 || ':' || '1' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, repo, path LIMIT 20
